body:
This should prevent the crash.
For completeness' sake, the workaround was introduced in 2019 by 7f63b0e8, to fix https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/23672. 6 years later, I think it's quite possible it's just not needed anymore (and @beicause [tested](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/108432#issuecomment-3065888126) that https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/23672 doesn't re-appear with this change in place).
